name: A data row has more or fewer fields than the header
detection: csv_read returns a csv::Error naming the record and line
attractor: the whole command aborts - check lists the error with the file path - analyze and matrix print it bare via entry
business_reaction: user fixes the row by hand using the line number
technical_change: none needed - the csv error already carries the line number

name: An affects cell has stray spaces or empty ids (a; b;;)
detection: not needed - deserialize_affects trims and drops empties
attractor: ids resolve normally
technical_change: none needed - handled by deserialize_affects

name: An affects cell lists the same id twice
detection: not needed - the BTreeSet collapses duplicates
attractor: one column marked once
technical_change: none needed - handled by the BTreeSet in deserialize_affects

name: User writes affects as c1 comma c2 instead of c1;c2
detection: in the file the unquoted comma breaks the field count so csv_read errors - from --affects the whole value becomes one id that fails id_chars_are_valid
attractor: the stressor is rejected before it is saved (CLI) or the file fails to load (hand edit)
business_reaction: user is told the row or id is bad but not that the delimiter is the cause
technical_change: mention the ; delimiter in the affects error message

name: An affects id no longer matches any component (renamed or deleted)
detection: check_rules reports 'references non-existent component' - incidence finds no match
attractor: matrix and analyze silently show 0 for that cell
business_reaction: a real coupling disappears from the report until check is run
technical_change: warn from matrix and analyze when a stressor references an unknown id

name: affects or covered_by uses Auth while the id is auth
detection: exact string compare in check_rules / incidence / test_cmd - check reports it as an orphan
attractor: matrix shows 0 - test aborts with 'must exist in stressors.csv'
business_reaction: user has to spot a case difference by eye
technical_change: none needed - ids are documented as case-sensitive and check catches it

name: A component id carries a trailing space in the file
detection: csv_read does not trim ids - check flags 'only numbers and letters allowed' - the trimmed affects id no longer matches
attractor: column exists with a padded id and every reference to it is an orphan
business_reaction: user sees two findings for one typo
technical_change: trim id cells on read or say 'whitespace' in the finding

name: Composed and decomposed accents make two visually equal ids
detection: not detected - exact byte compare
attractor: check reports an orphan that looks identical to a real id
business_reaction: user cannot see why the id does not match
technical_change: normalize ids to NFC on read

name: Spreadsheet save turns ids into numbers or dates (007 becomes 7 - 3-12 becomes a date)
detection: check flags invalid chars or orphan affects after the next load
attractor: ids change silently on every save so the matrix drifts
technical_change: document text formatting for id columns

name: An id cell is only spaces
detection: check_rules trims and reports 'needs id' or 'missing stressor id'
attractor: matrix prints a blank-headed column
technical_change: none needed - check catches it - matrix could skip rows with blank ids

name: A row leaves the id empty
detection: check reports 'needs id' - test_cmd labels the row 'Row N'
attractor: matrix column with an empty header - Display falls back to the empty id
technical_change: none needed beyond check

name: The same component id appears twice in components.csv
detection: check flags both rows - component add refuses a duplicate
attractor: matrix prints two identical columns - analyze lists the pair as coupled and as merge candidates
business_reaction: a data error masquerades as an architecture finding
technical_change: make matrix and analyze refuse or warn on duplicate ids

name: The same stressor id appears twice in stressors.csv
detection: check flags both rows - stressor add --id refuses a duplicate - auto ids use max+1
attractor: matrix prints two rows - test_cmd leverage counts the id once
technical_change: make matrix and analyze warn on duplicate ids

name: Two components share the same name
detection: not detected - names are never validated
attractor: matrix export header has two identical columns (export uses names while print uses ids)
business_reaction: exported CSV is ambiguous in a spreadsheet
technical_change: export ids alongside names or validate name uniqueness

name: Two stressor adds run at the same time
detection: get_next_stressor_id reads then writes with no lock - check reports the duplicate later
attractor: both rows get the same S<n> id or the appends interleave
technical_change: take a file lock or re-read just before the append

name: matrix runs while an append is in flight
detection: csv_read may see a partial last line and fail on the field count
attractor: run aborts with a csv error or shows a torn row
technical_change: write the row to a temp file and rename it into place

name: The disk fills during a write
detection: write or flush returns ENOSPC and the error propagates
attractor: csv_append leaves a truncated last row so the next load fails - export and analyze leave a partial report
business_reaction: the next command fails until the row is deleted by hand
technical_change: temp-then-rename for every write

name: User presses Ctrl-C during a write
detection: not detected
attractor: same torn-file outcome as disk_full_mid_write
business_reaction: next load fails on the torn row
technical_change: temp-then-rename for every write

name: architecture/ is read-only but its files are not
detection: append_csv still succeeds because dir perms only block new files - create_dir_all for reports fails
attractor: component add works - analyze prints its whole summary and then dies with a bare 'Permission denied (os error 13)'
business_reaction: user does not know which path was denied
technical_change: include the path in IO errors

name: reports/ cannot be created or written
detection: create_dir_all or from_path fails
attractor: export aborts - analyze prints the summary then fails after all the output
business_reaction: the summary looks complete but no file was saved
technical_change: write the report before printing or print the path in the error

name: Any OS error opening a CSV (missing - permission - name too long)
detection: csv::Error Io displays only the OS message
attractor: analyze and matrix print 'No such file or directory (os error 2)' with no file name - check prepends the path
business_reaction: user guesses which file is wrong
technical_change: wrap get_rows errors with the path and a 'run res init' hint

name: A CSV file is absent (before init or deleted)
detection: csv_read NotFound - each command handles it differently
attractor: analyze and matrix: bare error exit 1 - check: names the path - component list: 'Component file not found' exit 0 - stressor add prompt: 'no components yet' - component add and stressor add --flags create the file
business_reaction: inconsistent exit codes and messages for the same fault
technical_change: unify the not-found handling with a 'run res init' hint

name: Tool is run from a nested directory of the project
detection: paths are relative to the cwd
attractor: analyze fails with a bare not-found - init creates a second architecture/ inside the subdir
business_reaction: two competing architecture folders in one repo
technical_change: search upward for architecture/ or print the resolved path

name: Files are named Components.csv on macOS but the constant is lowercase
detection: not detected
attractor: macOS opens the file - Linux CI reports not found - init on macOS says no changes
business_reaction: works locally and fails in CI
technical_change: document the exact filenames in the not-found hint

name: components.csv exists as a directory
detection: not detected - reading the directory yields zero rows
attractor: check reports only orphan affects - analyze reports 0 components
technical_change: check that each path is a regular file before reading

name: Data lives in stressors.txt or similar
detection: not detected - constants are fixed filenames
attractor: file is ignored and a not-found error follows
technical_change: document the exact filenames in the not-found hint

name: File starts with a UTF-8 BOM
detection: not needed - csv crate strips it
attractor: parses normally
technical_change: none needed

name: Windows CRLF line endings
detection: not needed - csv crate accepts CRLF
attractor: parses normally
technical_change: none needed

name: Empty lines between data rows
detection: not needed - csv crate skips empty records
attractor: parses normally
technical_change: none needed

name: Last row has no trailing newline
detection: not needed - csv reads it and ensure_last_char_is_new_line adds one before appending
attractor: parses and appends correctly
technical_change: none needed

name: A cell contains a comma and is quoted
detection: not needed - csv crate handles quoting - check rejects commas inside ids
attractor: parses normally
technical_change: none needed

name: A stressor name holds a newline (Alt-Enter in Excel)
detection: csv reads the quoted newline fine - not detected as a problem
attractor: print_matrix label breaks the row across two lines
technical_change: replace newlines with spaces when printing labels

name: A hash comment line is added to a CSV
detection: csv_read fails with a field-count error naming the line
attractor: file fails to load
technical_change: enable csv comment handling or document that comments are not allowed

name: File saved as TSV or with EU semicolons
detection: header becomes one column so serde reports missing field id
attractor: file fails to load with a message that does not mention the delimiter
business_reaction: European exports look broken for no reason
technical_change: detect a single-column header and hint about the delimiter

name: File contains invalid UTF-8 (latin-1 save or truncated download)
detection: csv parse error with record - field and byte index
attractor: file fails to load
technical_change: none needed - the error is precise

name: Editor saves the file as UTF-16
detection: interleaved NUL bytes are valid UTF-8 so ids come out as garbage - check flags 'only numbers and letters allowed in id'
attractor: the file loads but every id is wrong
technical_change: detect a UTF-16 BOM and refuse the file

name: Spreadsheet reorders the columns
detection: not needed - serde binds by header name
attractor: parses normally
technical_change: none needed

name: Editor adds an empty trailing column to header and rows
detection: not needed - serde ignores unknown columns
attractor: parses normally
technical_change: none needed

name: A row gains an extra cell but the header does not
detection: csv field-count error with the line
attractor: file fails to load
technical_change: none needed - error names the line

name: A header name has a leading space
detection: not detected for Option fields - a padded id header gives missing field id
attractor: a padded name header silently becomes None for every row so lists and exports show ids instead of names
technical_change: trim header names on read

name: Header is Id or NAME instead of lowercase
detection: Id fails with missing field id - NAME silently maps to None
attractor: required fields fail loudly while optional ones vanish quietly
technical_change: match headers case-insensitively or validate the header row

name: A header like detction is misspelled
detection: not detected - serde treats it as an unknown column
attractor: that column reads as None for every row
business_reaction: data silently missing from future reports
technical_change: validate the header row against the struct fields in check

name: The header has two name columns
detection: serde error duplicate field name
attractor: file fails to load
technical_change: none needed

name: A new Option field is added to Stressor
detection: not needed - missing columns become None and old binaries ignore new columns
attractor: old files load under the new binary and vice versa
technical_change: none needed - keep new fields Option because a required new field would break every existing file

name: stressors.csv or test.csv lacks affected_components
detection: deserialize error missing field affected_components
attractor: file fails to load
technical_change: none needed

name: test.csv lacks naive_technical_change
detection: not detected - the field is Option so every row reads as a naive survival
attractor: residual index is 0 or negative with no warning
business_reaction: user thinks the residues did nothing
technical_change: require the column when running test

name: technical_change holds a single space
detection: not detected - Some(space) counts as a change needed
attractor: that test row counts as a failure
business_reaction: criticality drops for an invisible reason
technical_change: trim cells before testing is_none

name: test is given a path that does not exist
detection: is_missing_file_err
attractor: prints 'Test file not found' then 'No test rows to evaluate' and exits 0
business_reaction: CI passes a test that never ran
technical_change: return an error so the exit code is non-zero

name: covered_by cites an id that is not in stressors.csv
detection: test_cmd checks each id against stressors.csv
attractor: prints every bad id then aborts with exit 1 and no metrics
business_reaction: user fixes ids before seeing any score
technical_change: none needed - matches the documented behaviour

name: test.csv has bad ids or affects that reference unknown components
detection: not detected - check only audits components.csv and stressors.csv
attractor: covered_by errors surface only when test runs - unknown affects never surface at all
technical_change: extend check to test.csv

name: More than three residues tie for highest leverage
detection: not detected - leverage.iter().take(3)
attractor: only three are shown with ties resolved by id order
technical_change: show all residues at the cutoff count

name: Stressors are added before any components exist
detection: stressor add prompt refuses - --affects is rejected as an orphan - --name alone is saved with no affects
attractor: rows with all-zero affects
technical_change: none needed - check reports the orphans

name: components.csv is header-only or zero bytes
detection: not detected as a problem
attractor: matrix prints just the stressor column - analyze reports 0 components - check says everything looks good
technical_change: print an empty-state hint

name: stressors.csv is header-only or zero bytes
detection: not detected
attractor: analyze reports 0 stressors and lists every component as untouched
technical_change: note that no stressors are recorded yet

name: Every stressor hits the same number of components
detection: not detected
attractor: every analyze section says None because nothing is strictly above average
business_reaction: a dense uniform matrix reports nothing
technical_change: show the top rows even when they equal the average

name: One stressor affects every component
detection: not detected
attractor: hidden coupling grows to every pair of components
business_reaction: coupling section is quadratic in length
technical_change: cap or summarise the coupling list

name: Hundreds of components
detection: not detected - print_matrix never reads the terminal width
attractor: printed matrix wraps into an unreadable block while export is fine
technical_change: hint to use export when wider than the terminal

name: Terminal is narrower than the matrix
detection: not detected - terminal width is never read
attractor: rows wrap
technical_change: read the terminal width and truncate or hint

name: Non-ASCII ids such as café or CJK
detection: id_chars_are_valid accepts Unicode letters
attractor: column width uses byte length so glyphs and sums misalign
technical_change: measure display width instead of bytes

name: A stressor name is hundreds of characters
detection: not detected
attractor: label column widens to the longest name and every row follows
technical_change: truncate labels with an ellipsis

name: A column sum has more digits than its id (id ab with 120 stressors)
detection: not detected
attractor: sum overflows the column and shifts the footer
technical_change: size columns to the wider of id width and digit count

name: Tens of thousands of stressors
detection: not detected
attractor: get_rows loads everything and coupling is components squared times stressors
technical_change: stream rows or precompute column sets

name: architecture/ lives on a slow network mount
detection: not detected
attractor: stressor add re-reads stressors.csv twice per add and the prompt loops re-read files every iteration
technical_change: read each file once per command

name: Output is piped to head or a consumer that exits
detection: println! panics on EPIPE
attractor: exit 101 with a panic message - analyze never reaches the report write
business_reaction: scary panic and no saved report
technical_change: handle BrokenPipe as a clean exit and write the report before printing

name: Output is redirected to a file
detection: not detected
attractor: no colour codes are emitted but the box-drawing and Σ glyphs go into the file
business_reaction: fine for UTF-8 consumers and odd in ASCII tools
technical_change: offer an ASCII mode

name: component add or stressor add is run with no arguments in CI
detection: inquire errors with 'The input device is not a TTY'
attractor: exit 1 with a clear message - check never prompts
technical_change: none needed

name: User presses Esc partway through a stressor
detection: InquireError::OperationCanceled breaks the loop
attractor: the partial stressor is discarded and < exited > is shown
business_reaction: answers typed so far are lost
technical_change: none needed - documented in the help text

name: User presses Ctrl-C at a prompt
detection: inquire returns OperationInterrupted which propagates
attractor: exit 1 with 'Operation was interrupted by the user'
business_reaction: nothing saved for the current row while earlier rows are already appended
technical_change: none needed

name: component add with an empty id or stressor add --id empty
detection: check_rules 'needs id' or 'missing stressor id'
attractor: rejected with exit 1 - but --name empty is saved as a nameless row that displays its id
technical_change: none needed

name: A component id begins with a dash
detection: clap rejects -foo with a tip to use -- and after -- check_rules rejects the dash
attractor: never saved
technical_change: none needed

name: Ids are hand-written (malformed_csv - s7 - S03) instead of S<n>
detection: get_next_stressor_id only parses exact S plus digits
attractor: S03 counts as 3 so the next auto id is S4 - s7 and word ids are ignored
business_reaction: auto and custom ids coexist without clashing
technical_change: none needed

name: export or analyze runs twice within one second
detection: not detected - from_path truncates
attractor: the second file silently overwrites the first
technical_change: add a counter to the filename or refuse to overwrite

name: Hundreds of runs over months
detection: not detected
attractor: reports/ fills with timestamped files nothing reads back
technical_change: document cleanup or add a prune command

name: init is run on an existing project
detection: Path::exists checks
attractor: existing files are left untouched and 'No changes made' is printed
technical_change: none needed

name: Two init runs race
detection: create_dir_all is idempotent and both may write the same header
attractor: identical header written twice - harmless
technical_change: none needed

name: Excel holds the CSV open on Windows
detection: append fails with a sharing violation error that propagates
attractor: bare OS error exit 1
technical_change: include the path in the error

name: Locale formats decimals with a comma
detection: not needed - Rust formatting is locale-independent
attractor: index prints with a dot everywhere
technical_change: none needed

name: A stressor id equals a component id
detection: not needed - affects only resolve to components and covered_by only to stressors
attractor: no ambiguity
technical_change: none needed

name: A name contains a semicolon
detection: not needed - only affected_components and covered_by are split on ;
attractor: name is stored and shown intact
technical_change: none needed
